claim: AWS recommends Amazon SQS for use cases that need individual message delay: with Amazon SQS you can configure individual messages to have a delay of up to 15 minutes.

evidence.quote: We recommend Amazon SQS for use cases with requirements that are similar to the following:

Individual message delay. For example, you have a job queue and need to schedule individual jobs with a delay. With Amazon SQS, you can configure individual messages to have a delay of up to 15 minutes.
